test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.**

I am recognised for my contribution to the academic world.

options.text: People recognised me for my contribution to the academic world.
People recognise me for my contribution to the academic world.
People recognise me for their contribution to the academic world.
I recognise for my contribution to the academic world.

solution:
The correct answer is: "**People recognise me for my contribution to the academic world.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in passive voice.
 
• To convert it into active voice, we need to make the subject (**I**) the doer of the action and the object (**my contribution to the academic world**) the receiver of the action.
 
• The verb '**am recognised**' becomes '**recognise**' in active voice.
 
• The sentence structure changes from "I am recognised for my contribution to the academic world" to "People recognise me for my contribution to the academic world".

Therefore, **option 2** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1**: Incorrect as it is in active voice but the tense is incorrect. It should be "People recognise me for my contribution to the academic world" (present tense).
 
• **Option 3**: Incorrect as it changes the object from "my contribution" to "their contribution".
 
• **Option 4**: Incorrect as it makes the subject (I) the receiver of the action instead of the doer.
